description: Lets external agents (e.g. Claude Code) use the IDE's commands and state over the Model Context Protocol.

mcp.enabled.description: Run an MCP server on 127.0.0.1 so agents like Claude Code can use the IDE's commands (tools) and state (resources). Every start uses a new port and token; anything that changes files or runs commands asks you first.

mcp.claudeCode.enabled.title: Claude Code integration (/ide)
mcp.claudeCode.enabled.description: Let Claude Code find the IDE with /ide: a lock file in ~/.claude/ide and a local connection (127.0.0.1, a new token every start) through which it reads the selection, open editors and diagnostics and shows its edits as diffs you accept or reject. Terminals opened afterwards connect a Claude Code started in them by themselves.
